mission.statement: Characterize and construct connected unmarked planar Einstein tiles through new families, architecture-independent structural theorems, classification or nonexistence results, decidability boundaries, and certified methods that materially advance those goals.

programs.title: One-support realization and classification
programs.question: Which finite aperiodic local systems can be realized by one connected unmarked polygon with a total decoder on every tiling, and where are the construction, nonexistence, decidability, and undecidability boundaries?
terminal_outcomes: scoped undecidability theorem with meaningful decidable islands
programs.current_obstruction: Local finite-relation expressivity is available, but no general theorem forces the roles, contact topology, grouping, and total decoder using one unrestricted unmarked support.
programs.prohibited_default: Do not resume a source-specific carrier ladder without first stating the general hypothesis it tests or the theorem to which it can lift.

programs.title: Sturmian systems as realization sources and dynamical test cases
programs.question: Can a Sturmian aperiodic tiling system be realized by one connected unmarked polygon with a total all-tilings decoder, or can a meaningful realization class be classified or shown undecidable?
terminal_outcomes: connected unmarked Sturmian-derived Einstein with a complete proof
broad nonexistence or classification result for a stated realization class
unmarked undecidability boundary with decidable subfamilies
programs.current_obstruction: The AHI-specific carrier branch is closed. A new direction must change the general one-support realization problem rather than invent another encoding of the same finite source presentation.
programs.relationship_to_mission: This is a high-value test family for REALIZATION-GENERAL, not the sole definition of the repository.

programs.title: Structural characterization of connected unmarked Einsteins
programs.question: What architecture-independent invariants, dynamical mechanisms, contact structures, or deformation properties distinguish supports that can force aperiodicity from supports admitting periodic assemblies?
terminal_outcomes: necessary or sufficient theorem spanning recognized tile classes
classification theorem for a broad geometric or dynamical family
invariant or obstruction that changes constructive or discovery practice
programs.current_obstruction: Existing source-independent results classify several local enforcement mechanisms, but they have not yet been synthesized into a broad characterization of unmarked Einstein supports.

programs.title: Construction of a genuinely different Einstein family
programs.question: Can a support outside the currently known Hat--Turtle--Spectre mechanism be designed or discovered together with its complete all-tilings proof?
terminal_outcomes: exact new support or family with tilability and aperiodicity proof
general constructive recipe with a total-decoder theorem
architecture-level obstruction that redirects construction globally
programs.current_obstruction: No current candidate or admitted construction family exists. Candidate generation must be coupled from inception to periodicity and unrestricted contact-language gates.

programs.title: Certified discovery and verification methods
programs.question: Can exact search, certificate, or program-generation methods reduce a genuinely unclassified search space or verify a broad aperiodicity obligation more effectively than existing approaches?
terminal_outcomes: validated method on a sealed and externally meaningful problem
exact verifier or generator that materially advances another program
no-go showing that a proposed evaluation signal cannot support discovery
programs.current_obstruction: The historical polykite funnel lies inside a published classified horizon. No new computation is justified until an unclassified domain and an exact, research-relevant evaluator are identified.

selection.next_strategic_decision: After the documentation and harness authority cutover, compare the active programs as a whole and admit a field-relevant research thesis rather than resuming the final local residue of a historical branch.
